entries.name: locked-out-login
entries.summary: A user signs in with the locked-out account shown on the login page. The app stays on the login form and shows an error that the user has been locked out.
pre_conditions: A fresh session is open at the base URL
post_conditions: The user remains on the login page
The error says the user has been locked out

entries.name: valid-login
entries.summary: A user signs in with the accepted standard account shown on the login page. The app stays on the demo URL and renders the product catalog, including the Products heading.
pre_conditions: A fresh session is open at the base URL
